translation: [Figure: back bone figure 25] The back (背) is the general name for the region from the dazhui bone (大椎骨) of the posterior body downward to above the waist. Its bone is called the spine bone (脊骨), also called the lü bone (膂骨), commonly called the spine beam bone (脊梁骨). Its form is a single strip in the center, twenty-one segments in all, ending below at the tip of the sacrum (尻骨), carrying the two shoulders above, and internally connecting the viscera. The various bones on its two sides attach and overlap horizontally, and bend to join in front, and these form the chest and flanks.
